reviews.text: We found this cattery during the heatwave this summer, and since then our cat has felt almost right at home! Everyone there takes excellent care of the cats. Communication is fantastic! They always send photos, videos, and messages. We know our cat is in very good hands and that safety, hygiene, and plenty of activities are top priorities. We're so happy we found Ronrons, and our cat hardly wants to leave. Thank you for everything, and see you soon! 😊 Punch 🐈‍⬛ PS: We love your Instagram Stories.

An AMAZING place. We have used them several times, and our cats come back happy and calm (or wanting to play a lot since clearly they play a lot at Ronrons!).

Very nice staff, and we love the daily photos!

Hello team, my cat Grisou just returned from a 5-day stay. We usually always travel together, so you can imagine my initial apprehension... Between photos, videos, games, cuddles, and meeting other "cat buddies," while Grisou was happy to see me again, he didn't seem in any hurry to leave... He also had a lovely, delicate scent. While the care provided was undeniable, I want to thank the team for the psychological support they provided, both for the cats and their completely reassured humans. We'll see each other again on the next trip...
An exceptional hotel for our little British Shorthair cat. Lord had a wonderful stay. We highly recommend it and a big thank you to the RonRon team.

I left my cat at Ronrons Rive Gauche while I was away on a business trip, and I want to sincerely thank the entire team for their warm welcome, attentiveness, kindness, organization, and high level of professionalism.

I particularly appreciated the support provided, which began well before his stay: I was able to visit the premises beforehand, speak with the team, and ask all my questions. On the day of his arrival, everything was clearly explained to me, and I was able to accompany him to his living space.

I was also very reassured by the follow-up during his stay. From the very first day, I received updates on how he was settling in, what he had done that day, and photos. In the following days, I regularly received photos and videos, along with brief updates on his day and behavior. You can tell that there is genuine care and attention given to each animal.

For me, leaving my cat in this type of facility for the first time, the support I received truly made all the difference. I was able to leave with complete peace of mind and found him in excellent health, clearly very happy with his stay. When I came to pick him up, he was even still playing!

I therefore wholeheartedly recommend Ronron Rive Gauche to anyone who needs to be away and is looking for a reliable, caring, and professional place for their pet. A wonderful experience, and a team I will trust completely for any future stays.

An excellent experience! I entrusted my cat to this hotel and everything went perfectly. The team is very attentive, professional, and truly cares about the animals' well-being. You can tell they take care of each cat with great gentleness and care.

I was able to leave with complete peace of mind and I found my cat calm and in great shape. I highly recommend them and will definitely use their services again for my future trips. Thank you again! 🐾

My cat is elderly, ill, and requires medication at set times. It was with considerable apprehension that I entrusted her to Ronrons Rive Gauche for a week.

From the moment she arrived, the team knew how to put her at ease, adapt to her rhythm, and took wonderful care of her. When I had to extend my trip, they took the initiative to take her to the vet, just a short walk from the establishment, and provided her with the necessary care. I greatly appreciated their flexibility and kindness, and receiving daily updates, photos, and videos of my cat. It's very reassuring and allows me to maintain a connection and know that she's doing well, even from a distance.

The hotel is spacious, very clean, with a lovely play area and all the other guests are absolutely adorable.

I highly recommend this establishment for anyone needing to entrust their cat to trustworthy people for a few days. A huge thank you to the team for taking such good and gentle care of my Pepette!
The team at Ronrons Rive Gauche is fantastic and very caring. Don't hesitate to entrust them with your cat 🐱! …

I am more than satisfied with Jake's first stay at Ronron Rive Gauche, and above all, so reassured! 🥰
I entrusted Jake to this cattery for the first time with some apprehensions. He had never stayed in a cat hotel, isn't used to leaving his home, and it had been a very long time since he'd been around other cats. With his daily medication and sometimes fussy appetite, I naturally had some concerns.

And yet, what a surprise to see how quickly he adapted! Through the photos and videos I received during his stay, I discovered a happy, relaxed, curious Jake, and above all, having a blast with the other cats. I truly felt like I was rediscovering my cat, and it made me so happy to see him so content. ❤️
I also really appreciated receiving regular updates and knowing that he had eaten, drunk, and taken his medication. This allowed me to be completely at ease during my trip.

I already had a great feeling about this boarding facility during my first visit, after having visited several others, and I absolutely don't regret my choice. I now know that I've found the perfect care for Jake when I'm away and that I can leave him with complete peace of mind.

And what's more, Jake received a little gift when he left… It was so sweet! 🥰
A huge thank you again to Audrey, Lauralee, Jade, and the entire team at Ronron Rive Gauche for their kindness, their availability, and especially for taking such good care of my little baby. ❤️ I highly recommend Ronron Rive Gauche! 🐾

Hello Ronrons Rive Gauche,

A huge thank you to the entire team, who are simply wonderful.
I left my 6-month-old kitten with them for the first time for 5 nights, and it went exceptionally well. Impeccable cleanliness, exceptional availability, daily updates with photos and news, and top-notch safety and health. In short, nothing to say except bravo and thank you. Excellent value for money.

I'm so happy to have discovered this 5-star luxury cat hotel; it will become my little darling's second home when I travel.

I highly recommend it.

💖💗🥰
